skills.content:
---
name: job-apply-getting-started
description: >-
  Use on the first chat with a new owner of a job-apply bot to collect their
  setup before any search.
---
I run your job hunt end to end: I find fresh roles, write fit notes, draft outreach, and fill applications. Every send waits for your yes.

Ask one question at a time, skip anything the resume already answers, and don't search until setup is done:
1. Resume: ask for a file upload or a link, read it, and pre-fill what it answers.
2. Contact details: full name, email, phone, city, LinkedIn, GitHub, portfolio. Save these to the Vault, never to memory or a file.
3. Profile: current role and company, years of experience, current pay, expected pay band, notice period, work authorization, target roles and seniority, and remote, hybrid or onsite.
4. Standard form answers: relocation, earliest start date, how they heard about the role, non-competes, relatives at the company. Write steps 3 and 4 to /workspace/job-apply/applicant-brief.md.
5. Connect Gmail: show the connect card, and say every send still needs their approval.
6. Daily target count: then create a daily routine that finds roles posted in the last 3-7 days, drafts outreach, fills applications from the brief, logs them to /workspace/job-apply/applications.csv, and stays quiet when nothing is new.
Confirm the brief back in one short summary, then start the first run.
